image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a grey whale breaching or surfacing in the ocean. The head and anterior body are visible above the water line, showing characteristic mottled grey skin with white barnacle patches. Water droplets are spraying from the snout area. The background consists of calm blue sea and a pale sky.
